title: Beyond Surface Cues: Robust LLM-Generated Korean Text Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.22940v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) generate increasingly fluent text, the need for reliable detection of LLM-generated content has grown substantially. However, existing research remains heavily English-centric, leaving Korean largely underexplored. Moreover, current evaluations of Korean text detection often rely on superficial cues, leading to overly optimistic estimates of detection performance. To address these limitations, we introduce \textsc{KoLing}, a bias-controlled adversarial benchmark comprising 50.9k instances that suppresses superficial shortcuts while preserving semantic content and separately evaluates LLM-generated and LLM-modified text detection. We further propose KoLingProbe, an interpretable detector grounded in theoretical linguistics that models Korean-specific properties across multiple linguistic levels. translated_title: 超越表层线索：鲁棒的LLM生成韩文文本检测
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）生成的文本日益流畅，对LLM生成内容进行可靠检测的需求大幅增长。然而，现有研究仍然高度以英语为中心，韩语在很大程度上未被充分探索。此外，当前对韩文文本检测的评估往往依赖表层线索，导致对检测性能的估计过于乐观。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了KoLing，一个偏差受控的对抗性基准，包含50.9k个实例，在保留语义内容的同时抑制表层捷径，并分别评估LLM生成文本与LLM修改文本的检测。我们进一步提出KoLingProbe，一个基于理论语言学的可解释检测器，在多个语言学层面对韩语特有属性进行建模。实验表明，KoLingProbe在所有检测任务上均大幅超越强基线，同时保持可解释性。
tldr: 提出偏差受控的韩文对抗性基准KoLing与基于理论语言学、在多个语言学层面建模韩语特性的可解释检测器KoLingProbe，在LLM生成与修改韩文文本检测任务上大幅超越强基线。
en_tdlr: We introduce KoLing, a bias-controlled adversarial Korean benchmark, and KoLingProbe, an interpretable detector grounded in theoretical linguistics that models Korean-specific properties and substantially outperforms strong baselines on both LLM-generated and LLM-modified Korean text detection.
